comment: Inji Certify writes logo, background_color, background_image and text_color of credential_metadata.display as null when a credential configuration does not set them; the metadata schema allows a string or an object, not null (measured 2026-10-14).

Warning that follows the null display values: the suite then reports scope, cryptographic_binding_methods_supported and proof_types_supported of the SD-JWT configuration as unknown, together with credential_definition and credential_signing_alg_values_supported of the ldp_vc configuration FarmerCredential (measured 2026-10-14).
The credential configuration FarmerCredential uses the ldp_vc format of Appendix A.1; suite release-v5.3.1 validates only SD-JWT VC and mdoc configurations and warns about every other format.

current-block: Verify OAuth Authorization Server Metadata Response
comment: Inji Certify publishes interactive_authorization_endpoint and require_interactive_authorization_request, which come from a later OpenID4VCI draft (interactive authorization); suite release-v5.3.1 does not know them and warns.
Signed credential issuer metadata is optional and Inji Certify does not offer it: asked with Accept: application/jwt it answers the unsigned JSON document.
Follows from the unsigned answer: there is no JWT to decode, so the suite stops the module (INTERRUPTED with result FAILED).

The happy flow adds a parameter with a random name to the credential request to check that the issuer ignores it; Inji Certify answers HTTP 400 invalid_request "Unrecognized field ... in request" instead of issuing.

The suite authenticates at the token endpoint (private_key_jwt) and so puts its client_id in the iss claim of the key proof, as Appendix F.1 asks; Inji Certify rejects every proof with an iss claim ("JWT iss claim has value inji-conformance-wallet, must be" empty) and answers HTTP 400 invalid_proof.
